entry: ^Narrator: He is kneeling at an open junction box on the control run to the transfer switch. He doesn't stop working.
^Thomas Park: Four minutes and I'd have been out. Four.
hub: ^Read this. It's the projection for what you're covering.
^Who's paying you to cut the backup?
^Then finish it and see what happens. (Fight him.)
^Nothing. I was never here. (Back off. Next time he swings.)
refuse: ^Narrator: He doesn't look up. The stripped wire in his hand stays a finger's width from the terminal.
^Thomas Park: I lean four inches and this building goes to candles. Talk quieter.
paid: ^Thomas Park: Job's a building. Cut the backup, walk out, get paid. I don't ask about the rest.
^Thomas Park: Asking is how you end up in a room with someone like you.
projection: ^Narrator: You hold the page where the flashlight can find it. He reads two lines. The number is on the second.
^Thomas Park: Two hundred and forty. Three hundred and eighty-five.
^Thomas Park: They said a building. Empty, they said. Nobody in it.
^The building's empty. The people are on the other end of the wires.
^You've got four minutes. Spend them walking out.
stand_down: ^Narrator: He lays the wire down on the mat and puts his hands on his knees.
^Thomas Park: I'm not helping you. Put that on record. I'm just not doing this one.
^Thomas Park: The north trunk run's tapped. Months ago. Not me.
^Narrator: He picks up his bag and walks out past you, unhurried.

swing: ^Narrator: He comes up off his knees with the crimping tool swinging. This is going to be a fight.
lunge: ^Narrator: You give ground. He comes after you with the crimping tool. This is going to be a fight.

evade: ^Narrator: You back into the dark of the stairwell. He waits, then goes back to the junction box.

b: ^Narrator: He is still at the junction box, working faster. His flashlight finds the door before you're through it.
^Thomas Park: Second time. There isn't a third.

back_at_it: ^Narrator: He sets the wire down on the mat without looking round.
^Thomas Park: I said there wasn't a third.
last_chance: ^Narrator: He comes up off his knees with the crimping tool in his fist, and waits.
^Thomas Park: I said there wasn't a third. You've got one sentence.
gone: ^Narrator: The junction box cover is back on, finger-tight. His flashlight lies on the mat, burning down.
down_and_out: ^Narrator: He is out cold against the cable rack. The backup power stays up.
